name: Nevada
status_why: The Secretary's results sites sit behind an Incapsula bot wall.
system: Nevada Secretary of State's results pages (ASP.NET under www.nvsos.gov/SOSelectionPages/results/ and silverstateelection.nv.gov), behind Imperva Incapsula

results_page.label: Nevada Secretary of State: election results

feeds.address: https://www.nvsos.gov/SOSelectionPages/results/<year><Type>/ElectionSummary.aspx (2026StateWidePrimary for the June primary, per ballot/lists/nv.py)
feeds.updates: as counties report; mail ballots postmarked by Election Day count if received within four days, so totals move for days
feeds.note: 2026-10-09: www.nvsos.gov/SOSelectionPages/results/2026StateWidePrimary/ElectionSummary.aspx and silverstateelection.nv.gov/ both answered 200 with Incapsula's 212-byte stub (X-Iinfo header). In the Browser pane silverstateelection.nv.gov loaded only the Incapsula resource script and an empty page.

feeds.address: Clark: elections.clarkcountynv.gov redirects to https://www.clarkcountynv.gov/government/departments/elections/index.php; Washoe: https://www.washoecounty.gov/voters/ (results page not located)
feeds.note: Both county sites answer scripts for other files (the kit reads Clark's contest PDF and Washoe's contest workbook), but their results pages were not found in this pass.

races_in_feed: the state site carries federal, statewide, legislature, judges and multi-county races; each county clerk carries all local contests, cities included
local: Yes, 17 (16 counties plus Carson City). Clark (clarkcountynv.gov elections), Washoe (washoecounty.gov/voters); about nine in ten Nevadans between them.
how_counted: Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day count if they arrive within four days, so totals move for days.
count_order: Clark has reported early, mail and Election Day separately in its own files (not verified).
vote_types: unknown; Clark has historically reported early, mail and Election Day separately in its own files (not verified this pass)

certify.body: the Nevada Supreme Court's justices with the Secretary of State
certify.rule: On the fourth Tuesday of November (Nev. Rev. Stat. 293.395).
certify.local_rule: Counties on or before the 10th day (293.387).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: www.nvsos.gov and silverstateelection.nv.gov: Imperva Incapsula (212-byte stub to scripts; empty page in the Browser pane on 2026-10-09)
scout_plan: The state's own results cannot be read live. On election night Election Night could either show Nevada as 'results on the Secretary of State's site' with a link, or read Clark's and Washoe's own results files if a follow-up scout finds them answering scripts (Clark plus Washoe cover nearly every federal vote except NV-2's rural counties). Statewide totals then come from John's saved copy of the Secretary's page, or after the canvass (late November). Local results: Clark and Washoe first.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
